description: Source code for pitch period detection and fractional pitch search in AMR speech codec, including functions for normalized correlation, range calculation, and pitch encoding with sub-sample resolution.

methods.name: Norm_Corr
methods.description: Calculates normalized correlation between target vector and filtered past excitation over a range of delays.

methods.name: searchFrac
methods.description: Finds the fractional pitch by interpolating normalized correlation around a given lag.

methods.name: getRange
methods.description: Sets the search range around an open-loop or previous pitch estimate, bounded by min and max pitch limits.

methods.name: Pitch_fr_init
methods.description: Allocates and initializes the pitch detection state.

methods.name: Pitch_fr_reset
methods.description: Resets the pitch detection state to initial values.

methods.name: Pitch_fr_exit
methods.description: Frees the memory allocated for pitch detection state.

methods.name: Pitch_fr
methods.description: Main function to find the pitch period with sub-sample resolution, including normalization, search, and encoding steps.
